title: Market Chatter: JPMorgan-Led Lenders Prepare Up to $3 Billion Financing for Warburg's Pantherx Deal
title_zh: 市场热议：摩根大通牵头的贷款机构为 Warburg 的 Pantherx 交易准备高达 30 亿美元的融资
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co (JPM) led group of lenders is arranging a financing package of up to $3 billion
summary_zh: 摩根大通 (JPM) 领导的贷款机构正在安排高达 30 亿美元的融资方案

title: New York Yankees, Apollo in Talks for $3 Billion Financing Deal
title_zh: 纽约洋基队与 Apollo 正在洽谈 30 亿美元融资协议
summary: The New York Yankees, the most successful team in Major League Baseball history, are in advanced talks with  Apollo  Global Management to raise about $3 billion of financing, people familiar with the matter said.
summary_zh: 知情人士称，美国职业棒球大联盟历史上最成功的球队纽约洋基队正在与阿波罗全球管理公司进行高级谈判，以筹集约 30 亿美元的资金。

title: New York Yankees in Talks With Apollo Over $3 Billion Financing Deal
title_zh: 纽约洋基队与 Apollo 就 30 亿美元融资交易进行谈判
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The New York Yankees are in advanced talks to raise nearly $3 billion dollars of financing from Apollo Global Management Inc., people with knowledge of the matter said, as more institutional capital flows into professional sports.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——据知情人士透露，随着越来越多的机构资本流入职业体育运动，纽约洋基队正在就从阿波罗全球管理公司筹集近 30 亿美元融资进行深入谈判。

title: AI Push to M&A-Starved Loans Gains Fuel With Supersized QTS Deal
title_zh: 人工智能推动并购匮乏的贷款通过超大规模的 QTS 交易获得动力
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Wall Street banks, scouring every corner of the capital markets to finance the artificial intelligence buildout, have landed on a new pool of funds: US leveraged loans, which are clamoring for the transactions amid a dearth of buyout deals.Most Read from Bloombe...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——华尔街银行在资本市场的各个角落为人工智能建设提供资金，他们已经找到了一个新的资金池：美国杠杆贷款，这些贷款在收购交易匮乏的情况下迫切需要交易。

title: Apollo Lands Record $35 Billion AI Credit Deal, Challenging Wall Street Banks
title_zh: Apollo 达成创纪录的 350 亿美元人工智能信贷交易，给华尔街银行带来挑战
summary: Apollo structured a record financing for Broadcom and Anthropic while keeping the debt off Broadcom's balance sheet.
summary_zh: Apollo 为 Broadcom 和 Anthropic 提供了创纪录的融资，同时将债务排除在 Broadcom 的资产负债表之外。
